name: @lampgenie/code-sense-cli
description: codesense CLI——把 code-sense 静态调用索引包装成独立命令行/MCP 服务(零 lampgenie-harness 运行时依赖)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js --external:ts-morph --external:web-tree-sitter --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && chmod +x dist/cli.js || true
scripts.prepack: node -e "const{existsSync}=require('node:fs');if(!existsSync('dist/cli.js')){console.error('[prepack] dist/cli.js 缺失——先 pnpm build 产出 bundle 再打包');process.exit(1)}"
